Hopf trace on oriented complementary faces yields χ(g)=sgn(g)(T0−T1+T2−T3+T4). For each reflection the signed terms at fixed vertices, swapped pairs, triangles and 4-blocks give the stated parity/axis formulas, exactly matching the already published proof.
